fields.statement: QA at 90f39160 with a -trimpath build: in a scratch Rhiza root, an outer workflow including an inner one whose head-build step runs sh -c "${SHIP_HEAD_BUILD:?...}" (bugfix's shape) succeeded using the outer [env]'s SHIP_HEAD_BUILD (the inner's was ignored) with GOTMPDIR the run's tmp; with no SHIP_HEAD_BUILD in the outer [env] the step failed with 'SHIP_HEAD_BUILD: is not set' and the run failed. bugfix.toml's SHIP_HEAD_BUILD built a working rhiza; rhiza workflow check passes for ship-change, bugfix, docs, plan-bug, docs-build and docs-review.
